description: `between` requires the value and both bounds to be all-number or all-word; mixing a number value with a word low-bound raises `ol-type` naming the mismatched bound's concept "number" (spec/execution-model.md:146-166, error-model.md `ol-type`). Measured, this implementation's checker reports nothing for this program, so Phase 2 begins and execution halts at the failing statement, keeping the `instruction` event asserted below. The operands are literals, so the fault is statically knowable: `spec/tooling.md:197-200` says a semantic tool SHOULD report statically knowable uses of runtime C10 codes, so a checker that folded this call would report it at `semantic` and would also conform. The stage below records what this implementation does, not an inherent property of the fault. Issue #99; see issue #1156 for the superseded rationale.
